```mermaid
flowchart LR
  A["Main-sequence star"] --> B["Core hydrogen runs out"]
  B --> C["Red giant"]
  C --> D["Core helium burning"]
  D --> E["AGB star"]
  E --> F["Outer layers ejected"]
  F --> G["Planetary nebula"]
  G --> H["White dwarf"]
```

*What to notice: low-mass stars die through structural change and mass loss, not explosion.*
